minerals.label: steel
minerals.why_home: Steel is the one broadly present metal (D2: about 10 per map in rocky biomes).

minerals.label: gold
minerals.why_home: hydrothermal vents concentrate gold into nodules you gather (Scald floor spec)
minerals.why_second: no rock biome carries gold veins (Q3.1); only the canyon rivers wash fines out; Blue Desert meteoritic gold dropped to keep one land route

minerals.label: silver
minerals.why_home: iron-nickel meteorites kept at the ice surface carry silver; the plateau is the meteorite field
minerals.why_second: silver needs a meteorite field or a vent; the Scald floor is the only vent field

minerals.label: uranium
minerals.why_home: the Wastes are radiologically live: enrichment pockets and blast glass
minerals.why_second: no other land biome has a radioactive past; the Scald vents carry a little

minerals.label: chimney iron
minerals.why_home: black-smoker chimneys at the only hot vent field
minerals.why_second: NONE: the Scald floor is the only hydrothermal vent field on the planet

minerals.label: magnetite
minerals.why_home: vent magnetite (sea_dive_maps_spec.md:522)
minerals.why_second: magnetite also sorts into black-sand ribbons, and only the dune sea has the wind to sort it

minerals.label: uraninite
minerals.why_home: vent uraninite nodules (spec :523)
minerals.why_second: NONE: the Wastes already carry uranium as plain ore; a uraninite cell there would count the same metal twice

minerals.label: zersium
minerals.why_home: owner 10-09: zersium is the Forge biome's mineral; durasteel = steel + zersium
minerals.why_second: NONE: a second biome would undo the Forge ruling and D9 (no meteoritic zersium); off-Forge route is trade (step 2 fix)

minerals.label: phrikite
minerals.why_home: owner 10-09: 'a rare desert phrikite deposit in ONE desert'; D7 Stillsand
minerals.why_second: NONE: owner said ONE desert; phrik itself is traded

minerals.label: live pattern metal
minerals.why_home: BUILT deep lump under the living Cathedral
minerals.why_second: only mechanoid ground holds it; the Warscar is the war's graveyard

minerals.label: dead smartsteel
minerals.why_home: BUILT salvage seam of the Cathedral
minerals.why_second: only mechanoid ground holds it; the Warscar is the war's graveyard

minerals.label: jade
minerals.why_home: stone country: jade in the weeping walls and in the river cobbles
minerals.why_second: jade needs exposed metamorphic stone; the canyon's deepest cut is the only other exposure

minerals.label: diamond
minerals.why_home: the deepest rock on the planet, under the cold maps
minerals.why_second: diamonds need depth or an impact; the Chill crater is the only impact site

minerals.label: ruby
minerals.why_home: the Forge's contact-metamorphic heat makes corundum red
minerals.why_second: ruby needs marble or heat; the Weeping Stones' marble is the only other host

minerals.label: sapphire
minerals.why_home: nunatak corundum exposed by ice ridges
minerals.why_second: a placer gem: only the plateau's wind-stripped gravels keep it

minerals.label: pyrinth
minerals.why_home: BUILT gate: the Deeps' fire-crystal
minerals.why_second: the Scald floor (spec :525) is the only other place hot and deep enough

minerals.label: kyber crystal
minerals.why_home: kyber grows in the crystal caverns (canon Ilum caves)
minerals.why_second: NONE: owner red line 'kyber goes to the caverns' (the_propane_lakes.md:141,169)

minerals.label: stygium
minerals.why_home: owner 10-09: only in the Deeps' crystal formations
minerals.why_second: NONE: ruled Deeps-only

minerals.label: mindstone
minerals.why_home: a placed custom location (the_lantern_deeps.md:168, F12)
minerals.why_second: NONE: it is a single placed site, not a distribution

minerals.label: cave crystal
minerals.why_home: 'mined from crystal caves' (def text)
minerals.why_second: the Cauldron's mineral-furred trunks are the only surface crystal growth

minerals.label: Mother-of-Scaldpearl
minerals.why_home: a vent growth, named for the Scald (spec :521)
minerals.why_second: NONE: it grows only on the Scald's vents

minerals.label: obsidian
minerals.why_home: volcanic glass of the one mountain
minerals.why_second: only volcanoes and impacts make glass; the Abyss is obsidian-COLOURED stone, not glass, and stays empty (D4)

minerals.label: lanternstone
minerals.why_home: the Deeps' own rock (BUILT; deep leak closed)
minerals.why_second: NONE: it is the Deeps' rock; anywhere else it would not be lanternstone

minerals.label: glass sand / fine sand
minerals.why_home: BUILT glass-sand sieve
minerals.why_second: both are owner-ruled (10-09 transparisteel from the extreme desert's fine sand); terrain-scale, so not 'minor'

minerals.label: fossils
minerals.why_home: RULED canyon-wall fossils
minerals.why_second: fossils need a deep cut or a trap; the tar pits are the trap

minerals.label: blue ice
minerals.why_home: the oldest ice on the plateau (def text)
minerals.why_second: blue ice forms where wind scours old ice; the Sleeping Ice nunataks are the only other place

minerals.label: crystal salts
minerals.why_home: BUILT great salt crystals of the terminal sea (and its floor)
minerals.why_second: salt crystals need a hypersaline body; the Wastes' brine pools are the only one on land
minerals.defs: RM_RawSalt RM_SaltWhite RM_SaltPink RM_SaltViolet RM_SaltAmber RM_SaltCameo

minerals.label: cooking salt
minerals.why_home: the dead-river salt plains (wastes.md:246)
minerals.why_second: the deep desert's cavern seeps are the only other brine on land

minerals.label: brine plate
minerals.why_home: made by the Wastes' brine-battery colonies
minerals.why_second: NONE: organism-made; an animal belongs to one biome (standing principle)

minerals.label: bezoars
minerals.why_home: made by the Wastes' excretor herds
minerals.why_second: NONE: organism-made; an animal belongs to one biome (standing principle)

minerals.label: deepchem
minerals.why_home: the planet's oil sump (the_sump.md)
minerals.why_second: the hydrocarbon ladder runs Pyrelands to Sump to the nightward fuel lands; the Pyrelands stay empty (D4)

minerals.label: helixien gas
minerals.why_home: gas under the crater (10-03 proposal)
minerals.why_second: the Chill sea itself is propane: no drilling
